name: Suxin Joyful Life Services Co., Ltd.
summary: Suxin Joyful Life Services Co., Ltd., based in Suzhou since 1994, provides property management and related services across China. Its urban services include cleaning and maintaining city roads and tram platforms, inspecting water mains and street lighting, and refurbishing building facades. It also manages museums, libraries, parks and offices, as well as commercial and residential properties.
